observation.visible_scene: A brightly lit dance studio with white walls, a ceiling of track spotlights, an air-conditioner unit high on the left wall, and a full-length mirrored wall on the right. A young woman with a dark ponytail, wearing a white sleeveless collared shirt with a loose black tie, a short black pleated skirt, knee-high black socks with white stripes, and black sneakers, dances in front of the mirror. The figure seen inside the mirror is her reflection, not a second person.
visible_changes: At the start (frames 1-5) she stands still facing the mirror, hands pressed together near her chest; the reflection shows her front.
From about frame 6 to 16 her hands separate and swing down/outward while she lifts one heel off the floor and does a small bounce; the tie sways with the motion.
From frame 17 to 22 she raises both open palms to shoulder/face height and bounces on both feet.
From frame 23 to 30 her arms extend to the sides and her torso begins rotating away from the mirror.

From frame 31 to 41 she has turned to face the camera, smiling, with arms spread wide and palms open, continuing a stepping/bouncing move; the mirror reflection now shows her back/side profile, consistent with her rotation.
The background (lights, AC unit, mirror seams, floor) stays fixed across all frames, indicating no camera movement; the dancer remains in roughly the same floor location throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: The beginning and end of the dance routine, the music, and any moves before frame 1 or after frame 41 are not shown.
Whether the excerpt is one continuous take or part of a longer edited sequence cannot be confirmed from the frames alone.
uncertain_details: The exact choreography names and intent are not determinable.
Minor positional shifts of the body are hard to quantify; the main observable change is the arm/leg motion and the body rotation from facing the mirror to facing the camera.
